subject: Proposed payment waterfall & VAT evidence for Nordic rollout
messages:
From: Sigrid Holm <sigrid.holm@nordichealth.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: finance@nordichealth.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00+01:00
Subject: Request: extended terms + VAT handling for Nordic rollout

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — we loved the latency numbers. As we move toward procurement I need to confirm two things from a billing perspective so our CFO sign-off can proceed this month:

1) Payment terms: can Redwood offer Net60 on the initial contract? Given cashflow timing across our hospitals a 60-day window would help.
2) Credit ceiling: we will need a credit line of ~EUR 150,000 while invoices are in flight (est. 3–4 months).

Also, Sweden requires a VAT-reversal confirmation on invoices for cross-border B2B; please confirm you can include our VAT registration number on invoices and supply a signed VAT evidence letter.

Attaching our PO and a short procurement note (NordicHealth_PO_987.pdf). Can you propose a collection schedule that meets our Net60 ask while giving Redwood some mitigation for exposure?

Best,
Sigrid
Sigrid Holm
Head of Procurement — NordicHealth

[attachment: NordicHealth_PO_987.pdf]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sigrid Holm <sigrid.holm@nordichealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-03T11:15:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Request: extended terms + VAT handling for Nordic rollout

Hi Sigrid — thanks for the note and the PO. We can work with Net60 but propose a staged waterfall to reduce credit exposure while meeting your cashflow needs. Outline below — happy to iterate:

Proposed payment waterfall (RDW counter):
- 30% upfront deposit within 7 days of contract signature (applied to first invoice).
- Monthly invoicing thereafter on the 1st of the month for usage during prior month.
- Remaining 70% billed monthly, standard Net30 on each invoice (effectively gives you ~Net60 on average for first two months).
- Redwood agrees to a temporary credit ceiling of EUR 150,000 during the first 120 days, subject to milestone review.

Risk mitigations we require:
- VAT evidence: please attach your VAT registration certificate (scan is fine) and confirm the VAT ID we should print on invoices.
- Trade references / recent financials or a simple credit check so we can lift the ceiling after 60 days if payment history is clean.

Alternative: if NordicHealth prefers no upfront deposit, we can accept a 10% deposit + an irrevocable standby letter of credit or DocuSign escrow instruction to cover the first two invoices.

I attached a simple waterfall template for your review (redwood_proposed_waterfall.xlsx). If this looks OK we can get legal to prepare a short addendum and generate a DocuSign for signatures.

Cheers,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Lead, EMEA — Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +44 20 7946 0xxx

[attachment: redwood_proposed_waterfall.xlsx]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-04T09:03:00+01:00
Subject: Fwd: Proposed payment waterfall & VAT evidence for Nordic rollout

Marcus — forwarding for risk review. Key asks from Olga's counter: 30% deposit or 10% + LOC, temporary EUR 150k credit ceiling, VAT certificate required.

Short thoughts:
- If we accept 30% deposit + monthly Net30 for remainder, exposure is materially reduced.
- If they insist on Net60 with no deposit, I recommend limiting to Net45 until we see two on-time payments.
- We should run a quick credit check and request two trade refs.

Can you confirm the risk appetite and whether finance is comfortable with the 150k ceiling for 120 days given their ARR profile? If not, propose a lower ceiling (e.g., 75k) and require LOC.

Thanks — LM

Laura Bennett
Finance Partner, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

From: Magnus Eriksson <magnus@accountingservices.se>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: sigrid.holm@nordichealth.com
Date: 2026-11-06T14:22:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Proposed payment waterfall & VAT evidence for Nordic rollout

Olga / Laura — thanks for the quick response and sensible options. NordicHealth is happy to accept the staged approach:

- We will provide a 30% deposit within 7 business days of receiving the contract addendum.
- Monthly invoices should be batched and issued on the 1st of each month (preferred).
- We will supply the VAT registration certificate (attached) and confirm the VAT ID to be printed on invoices.
- Please issue a DocuSign link for the addendum and the payment terms so we can sign and trigger the deposit.

One operational ask: can invoices be grouped into a single monthly PDF (one invoice per month) rather than multiple small invoices? That helps our AP process.

Attached: NH_VAT_certificate.pdf

Regards,
Magnus Eriksson
External Accounting — NordicHealth

[attachment: NH_VAT_certificate.pdf]
